title: The music sim update
notes: Getting heard: a streaming dashboard with monthly listeners, streams and your top cities; playlist pitching; a radio airplay map station by station; four charts (Hot Country Songs, Country Airplay, Streaming, Top Country Albums); a weekly numbers report; and viral clips.

Better music: every song has lyrics, melody, hook, production and performance scores. There's an A&R listening session with hit potential before release, a melody game where you build the hook note by note (and the song plays it), a rhyme game, market trends, and remixes and features.
Skills and gear: practice mini-games, learn piano, banjo, fiddle and pedal steel, a gear shop, a home studio you build up, and session players on call (More → Gear, practice and studio).
Releases: plan each release (this Friday, a teaser campaign, a surprise drop, or wait out a crowded week), build hype with an album rollout, and watch an animated release-day reveal.
Live: a fan map by city that changes tour sales, live ticket sales when you announce a tour, and festival season where you climb the bill to headliner.
A career milestone track and a discography page with your greatest hits.
